thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-09-16 continue to reflect elevated geopolitical and economic strains, including reports that the Iran conflict has cost the EU €90bn in extra fuel expenses, trade tensions between the EU and China, and carryover pressures from Treasury yields reaching multi-year highs alongside high energy prices. Company-specific items in the pack (Meta Muse subscriber monetization, Korn Ferry M&A, generic long-term stock recommendations, routine politician filings) offer no compelling catalyst for altering our current allocation. Holding our balanced 4-position book—anchored by broad equity index VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and technology growth in NVDA and XLK—preserves proper diversification (cap 6), keeps all single-name positions well below the 35% cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and maintains our $35.00 cash reserve (~33% of equity vs the 15% floor) to absorb ongoing macro, rate, and geopolitical volatility without forced turnover.
